title: Membership Freeze Terms, Linden Memberships
content:
## Section 1: When a freeze is available

1.1 Where the tier permits a freeze, a member of Linden Memberships may freeze the membership in whole calendar months, up to the tier's maximum months per membership year, with at least the tier's minimum notice in days.

1.2 Freezing is the member's own request; only the member can ask for it.

1.3 A membership that is past due or in its notice period cannot be frozen.

## Section 2: Requests made ahead of time

2.1 A freeze, and a tier or cycle change that takes effect at the next period, is requested ahead of time as a membership request that the member submits.

2.2 The freeze or change is applied on its start date, and a request may be withdrawn until then.

## Section 3: Effect of a freeze

3.1 A freeze runs from the first day of a month to the last day of a month. During a freeze the membership is in status frozen; no dues are billed (the tier's freeze fee is billed per frozen month instead), no credits are granted, and member services are unavailable.

3.2 The commitment end date moves later by the frozen months.

3.3 The records of a freeze show its first and last day and the months frozen in the current membership year including that freeze.

3.4 When the freeze period ends, the membership resumes as active; its new period begins on the first day of the month after the freeze, and the monthly allotment of member visit credits is granted on that day.

## Status at the time of the request

| Membership status | Can be frozen |
|---|---|
| Active, on a tier that permits a freeze | Yes, within the allowance and with the notice above |
| Past due | No |
| Cancellation pending (in its notice period) | No |
| On a tier that does not permit a freeze | No |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A member on a tier allowing 3 frozen months per membership year, with none used, submits a request 10 days before the first day of the following month, on a tier requiring 7 days' notice, for a two-month freeze. The request gives at least the notice required, the months are whole calendar months and the total of 2 stays within 3.
- The same member later asks for two more months in the same membership year. Two months already used plus two more makes 4, above the allowance of 3.
- A request submitted 3 days before the intended start, on a tier requiring 7 days' notice, does not give at least the notice required.
- A member asks to freeze from the 15th of a month. A freeze is taken in whole calendar months, from the first day of a month.
- A freeze of 2 months on a membership whose commitment end date is 30 June moves that date later by 2 months.
